Bad North is a procedurally generated strategy game about fighting Vikings. Oskar Stalberg will talk about how the Wave Function Collapse algorithm is employed to magically assemble idyllic island dioramas from handcrafted tilesets. You'll learn about the theory behind WFC, its implementation and further development in Bad North, as well as the tools and pipeline surrounding it. Lastly, Oska …
